name: Lean Coding — Codex Python Beta
summary: Experimental Codex skill for lean Python maintenance: question redundant defenses while preserving real error contracts. Known regression checks passed; new-task quality, production readiness and speed/token benefits remain unproven.
description:
## Lean Coding — experimental beta

Four concise decision rules for Codex maintaining existing Python code. Use it when a requested edit involves redundant validation, defensive copies, exception handling, fallback values, retries or wrappers.

### What it guides

- Trace actual producers, callers, consumers and existing overrides before removing checks.
- Preserve public behavior, accepted input protocols, errors, cancellation, transaction atomicity and cleanup.
- Require a current requirement or demonstrated failure for each extra layer.
- Run the project's required checks and focused contract tests, then finish.

The instructions aim to reduce unnecessary machinery. A reduction in code, rework, execution time or token use has **not** been established.

### Evidence and limitations

Package version **0.7.1-beta.1**, using the unchanged v7.1 candidate. Six known development tasks completed successfully, with ordinary Python and `-O` checks. Two selected patches received reference-aware development review with no confirmed findings. These tasks informed the revision, ran once each and had no without-skill baseline. They are not unseen generalization or causal evidence.

The original v7 development window failed artifact review with a compatibility regression, and the earlier v6 generalization window failed its zero-confirmed-defect gate. Those findings and scores remain preserved. The latest known regression fix does not establish production qualification.

**This is an early free experimental preview. The original beta quality gate remains unpassed. No stable speed or token-saving claim, industrial production qualification, or Claude validation is offered.**

### Use

In Codex, invoke `$lean-coding` with the requested Python edit and the project's actual acceptance criteria. Read-only explanations, read-only reviews, documentation-only changes and non-Python work are outside the current scope. Follow the project's existing tools and permissions.

The package contains only `SKILL.md`, Codex UI metadata and the MIT license. It needs project file read/write and the existing Python/test shell. It adds no network service, bundled executable, extra dependency or paid API requirement. Model access follows your own Codex setup.

### Source, updates and feedback

MIT source, complete evaluation limits, installation instructions and preserved failures: https://github.com/junsier9/lean-coding-agents

Report reproducible issues at https://github.com/junsier9/lean-coding-agents/issues with the task, minimal code, expected/actual behavior and skill/model versions. Remove secrets and private project data. Future versions will include change notes; no update schedule is promised.

demo_result:
## Recorded known-development example

This is the complete final response from a real native Codex v7.1 development run, in its original Chinese. This is a previously known task, not a new production case or a performance comparison.

### Complete agent final response

已完成维护需求。

- `src/click/core.py`：为缺省的补全元数据使用默认值，恢复既有 `make_parser` 覆写和标准三元组接口兼容性。
- 新增 `test_parser_compatibility.py`：覆盖覆写、多值补全、别名、重复选项、类似选项名的合法值、异常传播及输入列表不变。

使用任务指定解释器运行 `-B -m unittest discover -v`，11 项测试全部通过；`git diff --check` 通过。内存还原旧逻辑后，新增测试成功复现 5 个兼容性错误。

未完成项：无。下一步：审阅当前补丁。

### Production patch from the same run

```diff
diff --git a/src/click/core.py b/src/click/core.py
index b279e62..451c111 100644
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -1194,8 +1194,9 @@ class Command:
 
         parser = self.make_parser(ctx)
         opts, args, param_order = parser.parse_args(args=args)
-        ctx._shell_complete_option = parser._shell_complete_option
-        ctx._shell_complete_options = parser._shell_complete_options
+        # Parser overrides may only implement the original three-value interface.
+        ctx._shell_complete_option = getattr(parser, "_shell_complete_option", None)
+        ctx._shell_complete_options = getattr(parser, "_shell_complete_options", True)
 
         for param in iter_params_for_processing(param_order, self.get_params(ctx)):
             value, args = param.handle_parse_result(ctx, opts, args)
```

### Separate evaluator result

The evaluator subsequently passed 28 focused contracts in ordinary Python and 28 in `-O` mode. These external checks are distinct from the 11 agent-authored local checks mentioned in the response. The frozen run also completed normally, and a reference-aware patch review found no confirmed defect. The package's other five known development tasks passed as well.

This demonstrates a compatible fix on known material. It does not show that the skill caused the result, saves tokens, or generalizes to untouched projects. The full development report and patch are retained in the source repository:
https://github.com/junsier9/lean-coding-agents/tree/main/evals/development-2026-10-28-v7-1
